subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 70 to
guide_solution: Summary River erosion is one of the major problems of Bangladesh. As a result of river erosion many rich families turn into beggar by losing everything. Meherjan is one of them. The violent river Jamuna washed away everything of Meherjan in the period of 24 hours only. If proper steps are not taken to prevent the problem, we will have to see thousands of new Meherjan every year.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Bogra Cantonment Public School & College. Sl. No. 23; Page No. 71
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 135 — Jamalpur Zilla School
